page_title: CLE 2-1 HAV | Clermont v Le Havre 17/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+8' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
90+6' The expression of the referee Marc Bollengier is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is shown a yellow card.
90+6' Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mory Diaw intercepts the ball.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) replaces Muhammed Cham.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' Le Havre work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
86' Le Havre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
86' What a great touch by Steve Ngoura (Le Havre)! He picks up a precise pass and produces a long-range shot, but his fabulous effort smashes off the right post!
85' Substitution. Loic Nego (Le Havre) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Arouna Sangante walks off.
85' Luka Elsner has decided to make a change. Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) replaces Andre Ayew.
84' Substitution. Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) on for Daler Kuzyaev.
81' Goal, no wait. Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for handball and Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) can't celebrate. Disallowed goal.

80' This should have been a goal! Muhammed Cham (Clermont) takes a mid-range free kick and his effort flies straight as an arrow, but crashes against the crossbar. The keeper only turned his head and stared at the ball.
79' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Clermont.
78' Alan Virginius comes off the pitch to be replaced by Grejohn Kyei (Clermont).
75' Pascal Gastien has decided to substitute Habib Keita and he is replaced by Maxime Gonalons (Clermont).
75' It will be a substitution. Jeremy Jacquet (Clermont) is ready to enter the pitch as Mehdi Zeffane walks off.
73' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
71' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
69' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Le Havre.
66' RED CARD! Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Marc Bollengier. He can have an early bath.
62' Le Havre quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
61' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Clermont due to an offside in the build-up play.
61' Luka Elsner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) replacing Emmanuel Sabbi.
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Abdoulaye Toure walks off the pitch to be replaced by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre).
60' Celebrations by Clermont are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
59' Goal! Alan Virginius (Clermont) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
58' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Marc Bollengier didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
53' There's an opportunity for Christopher Operi (Le Havre) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
52' Le Havre enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
48' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Andre Ayew (Le Havre) on the edge of the box.
48' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) is about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position, just outside the box.
47' A yellow card for a tackle by Johan Gastien (Clermont). Marc Bollengier doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' 2 - 1 Goal! Muhammed Cham (Clermont) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Arthur Desmas.
45+4' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+2' The foul by Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Marc Bollengier.
45+2' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) makes a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul. The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Clermont!!

45+1' 1 - 1 Andre Ayew (Le Havre) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Mory Diaw is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 1:1.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
41' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

39' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the right side of the goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Mory Diaw.
36' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
36' Neto Borges (Clermont) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Clermont have a corner.

36' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) was too forceful with his tackle and Marc Bollengier interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Clermont, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
34' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Marc Bollengier ignores the protests.
31' Habib Keita (Clermont) was probably a bit loose with his words to Marc Bollengier, who decides to show him a yellow.
30' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) is told to leave the pitch after receiving a red card from the referee for dissent! The manager looks really angry about his irresponsible behaviour.
30' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Marc Bollengier lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
28' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) sends the corner into the box, but Mory Diaw intercepts it and averts the threat.
28' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Le Havre.
27' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle and signals a foul after Johan Gastien (Clermont) brought his opponent down. Le Havre are awarded the free kick.
25' Alan Virginius (Clermont) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick inside the box and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
24' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) will take a corner kick.
22' Neat passing move from Clermont in order to create new attacking opportunities.
17' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. A free kick is awarded to Clermont.
16' The Le Havre players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
14' Marc Bollengier interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre). Clermont are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

12' 1 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Muhammed Cham (Clermont) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
8' Le Havre control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
6' A long pass into the box is latched onto by Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre), who looks up and slams a terrific shot past the keeper but onto the right post. He did everything right but score!
5' The free kick is taken by Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre), but ball is cleared.
4' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle after Habib Keita (Clermont) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a free kick to Le Havre in a dangerous position.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Le Havre will have the kick-off.
Marc Bollengier was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
